chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from ʿAli ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn ʿUthman, from al-Harith ibn Yaʿla ibn Murrah, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم passed away, and he was covered with a cloth. Behind the cloth was ʿAli عليه السلام at the edge of his garment, having placed his cheeks upon his palm, while the wind was striking the edge of the cloth against the face of ʿAli.
He said: While the people were at the door and in the mosque, sobbing and weeping, suddenly we heard a voice in the house saying: Your Prophet is pure and purified, so bury him and do not wash him.

He said: Then I saw ʿAli عليه السلام when he raised his head in alarm and said: 'Begone, enemy of Allah! For he commanded me to perform his ghusl, shroud him, and bury him, and that is the sunnah (prophetic tradition).'
He said: Then another caller, with a tone different from that one, called out: O ʿAli ibn Abi Talib, cover the private area of your Prophet and do not remove the shirt.

key_terms.بِغُسْلِهِ: performing his ghusl (ritual bath) before burial
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: the established prophetic tradition and normative practice
key_terms.طَاهِرٌ مُطَهَّرٌ: pure and purified; describing the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.عَوْرَةَ: the part of the body that must be covered
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; used here for the death of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about Imam ʿAli عليه السلام washing and burying the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates events surrounding the passing of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the role of Imam ʿAli عليه السلام in preparing him for burial. It indicates that Imam ʿAli عليه السلام rejected a contrary voice and affirmed that washing, shrouding, and burying the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was commanded and part of the sunnah (prophetic tradition).
